notes: The current Apps Script endpoint remains authoritative.
No PWA client is switched to the replacement API in this phase.
Financial routes, imports, backups and production cutover require separate owner-approved gates.
legacyActionMapSource: api/v1/legacy-action-map.json (source-controlled inventory; deliberately not served publicly)

authentication.csrfCookie: cv_csrf (Secure, readable, SameSite=Strict; echoed in X-CSRF-Token)
authentication.rateLimit: 5 attempts per 15 minutes per email and email/IP; 25 per IP
authentication.legacyPassword: HMAC-SHA256(UTF-8 salt:password, existing Apps Script PEPPER), imported as legacy-hmac-sha256$<salt>$<lowercase-hmac-hex>; normal-length credentials upgrade on login; short PINs require migration flag plus must-change and are rehashed only by compliant password change
authentication.roleResolution: Re-read active status and current legacy role from MySQL on every request
authentication.passwordPolicy: 8-128 characters; explicit must-change-only legacy short-PIN migration exception
